ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL) The petitioner herein claims to be the co-tenure holders of the land bearing old Block No./Revenue Survey No.14,
New Block/Survey No.274, Khata No.118, admeasuring H-3-71-15 Are, which according to him is co-shared by the respondent Nos.3 to 6 herein.

2. It seems that in an acquisition proceedings on determination of compensation under the award dated 3.11.2021, the petitioner had approached the respondent No.2 for release of compensation to Abhabhai Parsingbhai Pagi vs Executive Engineer on 11 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173713061/
1 the extent of his share in the property in question, through a legal notice, which was sent by his advocate.

entities.text: Abhabhai Parsingbhai Pagi vs Executive Engineer
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The said legal notice has been replied by communication dated 2.1.2023 from the office of the Executive Engineer concerning the respondent No.1 stating therein that NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/14088/2023 ORDER DATED: 11/09/2023 undefined since the petitioner has not obtained the consent of other co- sharers, the compensation cannot be paid to him.
3. In the instant petition, the challenge is to the communication dated 2.1.2023 issued by the office of Executive Engineer in reply to the legal notice sent by the petitioner through his advocate.

4. Noticing the above, we may record that the Chapter-IX as contained in the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ["Act of 2013" for short] deals with the question of apportionment of compensation.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Section 75 confers power on the concerned authority namely, the Special Land Acquisition Officer concerned to pass an award with the consent of the co-tenure holders, i.e. the persons interested in the land, on an agreement between them, for apportionment of the compensation.
However, in case of any dispute between the co-owners as to the apportionment, the same has to be referred to the authority under the Act of 2013, in view of Section 76 thereof.

5. We may further note that the petitioner has not approached the competent authority namely, the Special Land Acquisition Officer for disbursement of his share by submitting a proper application,
and straight away came to this court to challenge the reply given by the Executive Engineer to the legal notice, who has no jurisdiction in the matter of disbursement of compensation.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/14088/2023 ORDER DATED: 11/09/2023 undefined 6.

For the aforesaid, we relegate the petitioner to approach the Special Land Acquisition Officer namely, the Dy. Collector, Godhra, District: Panchmahals, - respondent No.2 herein by moving a proper application seeking for disbursement of the compensation to the extent of his share, along with the copy of this order, within a period of two weeks from today.

In case such an application is filed, the respondent No.2 shall be under obligation to issue notice to other co-tenure holders of the disputed property and decide the question of apportionment, strictly in accordance with the provisions of the Act of 2013.
With the above observations, the petition stands disposed of.
